item.title: Outgoing UN chief says polluters have treated atmosphere like an ‘open sewer’
item.description: António Guterres laments world leaders’ inaction and says oil and gas firms ‘must pay’ for climate devastation For one last time, António Guterres tried to fix the world’s gaze upon the dangerously escalating climate crisis. But the departing UN secretary general found world leaders still largely focused on other issues, even after a painful summer of stunning climate-driven disasters. Speaking to assembled dignitaries at the UN on Tuesday, Guterres railed against big oil for treating “the atmosphere as an open sewer” and warned again of the catastrophic effects of the climate crisis… Fuente: The Guardian - Environment.

item.title: Nicaraguan government responsible for at least 8 deaths in custody since 2018, U.N. report finds
item.description: The Nicaraguan government is responsible for at least eight deaths in custody since it began its crackdown on dissent and assault of democratic institutions in 2018, UN experts said Tuesday. The report from the UN Group of Human Rights Experts on Nicaragua was the latest condemnation of the government of married co-Presidents Daniel Ortega and Rosario Murillo, which has crushed dissent since 2018 mass protests and recently cancelled elections. “A State that resorts to enforced disappearance and... item.title: La oposición de Costa Rica acusa al Gobierno de Laura Fernández de “autoritarismo”
item.description: Durante décadas, Costa Rica operó como el último oasis de estabilidad democrática y seguridad en Centroamérica. Hoy, golpeado por una crisis de homicidios sin precedentes, el Ejecutivo impulsa una receta de ‘mano dura’ y reformas judiciales que abren un frente de colisión con la Corte Suprema y la oposición. Conversamos en France 24 con el diputado Edgardo Araya (Frente Amplio) sobre el riesgo de un quiebre institucional: ‘Nos preocupa terminar siendo como El Salvador’. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: Rodrigo Sedano
